question.problem:
The profits of a store $P(t),$ $t$ years after $2018,$ is given by

$$
P(t)={P}_{0}\cdot (1.1)^{t},
$$

where ${P}_{0}$ was the profit in $2018.$ If the profits in $2020$ were of $$48\,400,$ what was the profit in $2018?$
question.worked_solution:
The store profits in $2020$ were of $$48\,400,$ this is $2$ years after $2018.$ Thus, $P(2)=48\,400.$

To find the profit ${P}_{0}$ in $2018,$  we substitute $t=2$ and $P(2)=48\,400$ into the given equation and solve for ${P}_{0},$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(2) & ={P}_{0}\cdot (1.1)^{2} \\ 48\,400 & ={P}_{0}\cdot (1.1)^{2} \\ {P}_{0} & =\frac{48\,400}{1.21} \\ {P}_{0} & =40\,000\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the profits in $2018$ were of $$40\,000.$
